versions.subject: Split global rule
versions.detection:
sc_cmd:
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'sc config'
        - 'wercplsupporte.dll'
wmic_cmd:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|endswith: 'COR_PROFILER'
condition: sc_cmd or wmic_cmd
